errors.text_span: видимите етикети по X са 2008, 2012, 2013, 2017 и 2021
errors.evidence: The description lists five separate labels for the x-axis (2008, 2012, 2013, 2017, and 2021), but the figure shows only four labels: "2008", a single label that appears to be "20122013" or "2012/2013", "2017", and "2021". The description incorrectly splits the single label for the 2012-2013 period into two distinct labels.
